statuses.FULL: Every fill in the window the public API holds was served; ranked.
statuses.PARTIAL: The public API's horizon (the 10 000 most recent fills) cut the window; the figures are of the fills served; unranked.
statuses.NONE: Zero fills served in the window: nothing settled under this address on the perp L1 as the public API serves it; unranked.
statuses.REFUSED: A pinned page did not hash to its pin (S84); no figure is shown.
statuses.RECORD: The operator's own account: the same grader over its own pages, beside its committed run files that re-verify offline with L1 hashes.
statuses.PAPER: A paper fork of the contract marked on the environment tape: net basis points of its episodes inside the window, never a USD figure.
